title: Lock the heads-up dashboard
question: All three preserve Option 3. Choose the refinement to build, or describe a final combination.

options.label: Tight Matrix
options.thesis: The original matrix becomes calmer and denser without changing its information topology.
options.viewport: Four concise answers lead immediately into performance and attention, with evidence held in a quiet bottom ribbon.
options.risk: The evidence ribbon remains summary-level and requires a drill-down for cycle comparison.

options.label: Attention Explained
options.lineage: Heads-Up Matrix plus decision-grade issue detail
options.thesis: The matrix keeps its ten-second scan while the attention rail explains consequence, timing, and evidence.
options.viewport: The performance chart and explanation-rich attention table share the center, with a concise evidence ribbon below.
options.risk: The attention table adds density and must collapse carefully on smaller screens.

options.label: Evidence Dock
options.lineage: Heads-Up Matrix plus persistent custody table
options.thesis: The matrix keeps overview and performance above a first-class evidence and lineage dock.
options.viewport: Two evidence cycles, trust, freshness, checkpoints, lineage, and consequential events remain visible without leaving the dashboard.
options.risk: The evidence dock claims substantial first-view height and reduces breathing room around the main chart.
